description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json, adding convenience methods for converting objects to and from JSON strings.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Extension method to deserialize a JSON string into an object of type T.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Extension method to serialize an object of type T into its JSON string representation.
